job_description: We seek a Registered Nurse for a busy medical ward. Mandatory requirements: (M1) Current Registered Nurse (RN) licence/certification; (M2) Minimum 2 years recent clinical nursing experience; (M3) Experience with medication administration and IV therapy; (M4) Ability to manage multiple acute patients and escalate appropriately. Preferred: (P1) Experience with electronic medical record systems; (P2) Experience in wound care and pressure-area management. The role requires clinical judgement, teamwork, and demonstrated empathy in patient care.
candidate_profile: The candidate is a registered nurse with a current RN licence. Worked 18 months in a community clinic focusing on chronic disease management, regularly performed medication reviews and administered injections; limited IV experience documented during a 4-month hospital secondment. Has used an EMR at the clinic for patient notes. Evidence of strong patient-centred communication and teamwork.
